constraint_block:
[C-P1-01] (MUST) from P_1: Antiphrastic micro-ensemble
    Specification: The text contains >= 2 clauses predicating benevolent, charitable or pedagogical action -- in whatever words the target domain's own institutional register would use, chosen by you -- of actions the context marks as coercive or predatory, with NO narratorial correction or evaluative comment. Audited by listing the predications and checking that no evaluative lexeme falls inside their span.
  [C-P2-01] (SHOULD) from P_2: Embedded English metric verse (RE-DERIVED, not translated)
    Specification: Per the plan's option (b): the Italian syllabic meter does not port, so substitute the accentual-syllabic equivalent. The opening syntagm scans as iambic pentameter, and the passage embeds >= 2 blank-verse (unrhymed iambic-pentameter) lines inside descriptive sentences, doing the same iconic-pacing work below conscious scansion. Tag as RE-DERIVED. Verifiable by scansion. NB: the non-portability of the Italian meter is itself reported as a finding (option (a)).
  [C-P3-01] (MUST) from P_3: Conjunctive binary coordination
    Specification: The text contains >= 3 two-member coordinations 'X and Y' whose members share a lexical field (seascape/movement; e.g. 'in bays and inlets', 'swelling and subsiding'), with parallel syntactic shape. Verifiable by enumeration.
  [C-P4-01] (MUST) from P_4: Chiasmatic inversion of a recurring pair (presupposes C-P3-01)
    Specification: At least one P_3 pair introduced early recurs later with its members' order inverted (AB ... BA), across a span of at least one sentence. Verifiable by locating both loci and comparing member order.
  [C-P5-01] (MUST) from P_5: Sea duality — alternating contraction/dilation lexicon, full arc
    Specification: Two opposed lexical fields alternate over the single referent 'the sea': one of expansion, one of constriction. The words of both fields are yours to choose; none are supplied. The passage runs the full arc expansion -> constriction -> re-expansion. Audited by locating the two fields in the text and checking the arc order.
  [C-P5-02] (SHOULD) from P_5: Sea duality — juridical naming pivot
    Specification: The text contains >= 1 pivot sentence in which one and the same thing changes name or status across a boundary that is invisible in itself, the boundary made perceptible only by something outside the thing -- a document, an instrument, a record. Which naming systems collide is yours to choose. Audited by locating the cessation/recommencement predicates and the external marker.
  [C-P6-01] (MUST) from P_6: Specular doubling on a single head
    Specification: The text contains >= 1 syntactic frame with paired predications on a single element of the described world: a direct-perception predicate and a reflection or representation predicate carrying an inversion or transformation marker, with the mirroring medium named in the text. Which medium mirrors -- natural or instrumental -- is yours to choose. Audited by parsing the coordinate predications.
  [C-P7-01] (MUST) from P_7: Lucid waviness at the SYNTACTIC level — GLOBAL constraint
    Specification: Sustained across the passage: the periodic syntax UNDULATES — successive waves of expansion and contraction, clause groups swelling (in length and embedding depth) and subsiding in alternation: >= 2 full crest-trough cycles within the longest period, and >= 1 long multi-clause period — while hierarchy stays fully legible (no anacoluthon, recoverable syntactic tree). DEPTH THRESHOLD to be set from Moore's measured incipit (English tolerates less subordination than Italian; the Italian used depth 8). Verifiable by segmenting periods into clauses, plotting unit length/depth alternation, and parsing for legibility.
  [C-P7-02] (SHOULD) from P_7: Self-referential formula with PROLEPTIC function — NARRATIVE level
    Specification: The text contains one word, of its own choosing, that (i) denotes a physical movement in the described scene, (ii) reads as a description of the prose's own undulating syntax (the C-P7-01 waviness, named from within), and (iii) functions as a proleptic marker: the syntactic waviness prefigures a movement the ensuing narrative will unfold (cf. A9: 'prefigura già il complesso universo del romanzo'). The word is not supplied. Audited in the human reading; (i) is mechanical once the word is identified.
  [C-P8-01] (MUST) from P_8: Historicized-present puncture
    Specification: The surrounding description is in the atemporal/naturalistic present, punctured >= 1 time by a deictic phrase locating the description in the present of writing, governing a present-tense verb of ongoing change. The phrase is yours to choose and must not be the source's own. Audited by locating the adverbial and checking the tense environment.
brief:
- the strait of water between two shores: the Sicilian Channel, between the North African coast and the island of Lampedusa
  - the sea's juridical zones: international waters, the SAR search-and-rescue zones, territorial waters
  - the routes and the boats of the migrants
  - the lighthouse, the rocks and the inlets of the island
  - the vessels and personnel of rescue and control (Coast Guard, Finance Guard)
  - the first-reception center on the island
  - a fisherman of the island
